crossRefs.note: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba…

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

translations.web: He went up from there to Beersheba.
translations.bsb: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,
translations.kjv: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
translations.asv: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
